ops.title: Follow-up release riders: auto-updater off, pool fill failure record, helper check before the warm claim
ops.description: Three changes root asked for after v0.26.5, each its own commit on branch startup-riders: a remote Claude worker starts with DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1; a failed pool fill records its step, exit code, and error class; orca prepare --warm compares the helper pin before it claims.
